thread:
olivia: Quick plan for 'Autopilot' webinar (May 15). We need: X + LinkedIn bursts, 2 short threads (benchmark-first and demo-first), a 30s demo clip for X, hero static + gif, and HubSpot form routing. Who's owning what?

devin: I can cut a 30s demo clip from the product team footage. Need final script by Tue. Will do native X sizing.

tara: SDR coverage 1: EMEA mornings and PST evenings. Who's covering APAC?

jules: Tara takes EMEA. Devin will cover PST handoffs. Maria, can we get one APAC agent on the rota?

maria: Yup, adding Mei to the rota for APAC morning coverage. Also uploading asset checklist.

olivia: Copy goals: super short CTA for X ("Register"), longer post for LI explaining the benchmark delta and demo highlights. Bench thread should be 2-3 tweets max.

anshul: For bench thread include p50/p95/p99 and a short callout about cache/kv effects. Will attach a csv of the raw results. Also recommend a 1-sentence note on quantization tradeoffs.

maria: I'll create a stylized table PNG for tweet size and a full-res chart for the results repo. Keep text legible at 600x335.

devin: For the demo clip, can we overlay the benchmark microchart at 0:12? keeps context.

olivia: yes. Also plan an alt-post linking to a deep-dive blog for folks who want the raw table.

ops-bot: Reminder set 1: Schedule posts: May 10 09:00 PT (benchmark thread) and May 13 10:00 PT (reminder).

devin: HubSpot mapping ready. Quick snippet: 
```
form_fields:
- company_size -> hs_company_size
- vertical -> hs_industry
- trial_interest -> hs_checkbox_trial
- benchmark_interest -> hs_checkbox_benchmark
```
Will include utm_campaign=autopilot_may.

tara: SDR handoff rules: lead_score>70 OR company_size>1000 -> immediate SDR queue. Else nurture flow (3 emails over 14 days + LI touch). Confirm?

jules: Confirmed. Add region tag (sdq_region) and interest tags (benchmark_interest, demo_interest).

maria: Uploading hero static + gif v1 to /marketing/assets/autopilot by Mon EOD. Naming: autopilot_hero_card.png, autopilot_li_banner.png, autopilot_thumb.gif.

olivia: I'll drop copy variants into /marketing/copy/autopilot (short/long/threads). Please review by Thu EOD.

anshul: Also add a line in the thread copy linking to raw CSV: https://repo.company/results/autopilot.csv for transparency.

jules: One more ask: add tracking pixel + campaign tag for post-webinar attribution. @ops-bot can you create the campaign tag?

ops-bot: Campaign tag created (campaign=autopilot_may). Pixel snippet uploaded to the docs.

maria: Final comps uploaded v2. @olivia can you do a quick visual check?

olivia: Checked and approved. Scheduling doc updated with times/CTAs/shortlinks. Ready to schedule after copy freeze. :rocket:
